title: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
summary: Shortly after launching its new do-everything AI assistant Muse, Meta's launching subscription bundles that pair its standalone app subscriptions with extra AI usage. Some of the new Meta One bundles were in testing earlier this year, but are now available globally starting today
reason: Meta launched Meta One subscription bundles that pair app subscriptions with extra AI usage, reported by The Verge, a reputable media outlet. This is a product/business launch in the AI industry.
